dct_description_sm: The study was conducted to document Inuit Knowledge and values pertaining to the Torngat Mountains Caribou herd. The data was gathered to inform management of the species and document long standing knowledge of this species from expert hunters and Elders in Nain, Nunatsiavut and Kangiqsulujjuaq (George River), Nunavik.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Inuit Knowledge
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Interview
dct_title_s: Torngat Mountains Caribou Herd: Inuit Knowledge, culture and values study
